title: Code comments still source the SFX slots from Suno, contradicting the FINAL 2026-08-17 ruling (SFX = ElevenLabs) carried in README + PR body
evidence: app/audio/audio.odin:19-21: "// Asset-drop contract (see assets/audio/README.md): drop Suno files at\n// assets/audio/crisis_01.ogg .. crisis_03.ogg and arrival_01.ogg .." — audio.odin:6: "// placeholder tones when real Suno assets are absent, and an on-screen" — audio.odin:52: "// The placeholder loudness (real Suno files replace the slot, volume" — audio.odin:254: "// synthesized placeholder otherwise. The drop-in contract: dropping a Suno" — app/main.odin:204: "\t// (real Suno assets when present, synthesized placeholders otherwise;" — vs assets/audio/README.md: "**SFX — the two stings in this contract (crisis alert + arrival click):\n  ElevenLabs.**"
detail: The r1-W6 fold fixed the supplier story in README + PR body (SFX = ElevenLabs; music = Suno Premier) but missed the module's own comments, which still tell a reader to "drop Suno files" into the SFX slots — the settled ruling is contradicted inside the diff itself.
recommended_fix: Update the audio.odin header/asset-contract/load_variant comments and the main.odin init comment to name ElevenLabs for the SFX slots (Suno = music only), matching assets/audio/README.md.
